textos.Lançado em 2019 e dirigido por Guy Ritch: Released in 2019 and directed by Guy Ritchie, The Gentlemen is a 113-minute action, comedy and crime film. The plot follows a talented American Oxford graduate who builds a marijuana empire using the properties of impoverished English aristocrats. When he tries to sell his business to a billionaire, a chain of blackmail, deception, chaos and murder is set off, involving street thugs, Russian oligarchs, gangsters and journalists.
textos.A experiência é marcada pela cadência tí: The experience is marked by the cadence typical of Guy Ritchie's productions, structured around lengthy dialogue and editing that cuts across multiple narrative threads. The direction alternates passages of detailed verbal exposition with the dynamics of the criminal underworld.
textos.Os diferentes grupos convergem sobre os: The different groups converge on the central themes of the work, disagreeing on the verdict on how well these choices work. In the vast majority of ratings (~78%), most praise the cast's performances, a large portion extols the return to the director's signature style and storytelling, and a significant share highlights the humor and fun.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~17%), sob uma p: In a share of the ratings (~17%), from a middling perspective, the largest share recognizes the cast's work, but about half criticize weaknesses in the script and dialogue, while a good portion point to problems with pacing and running time. Finally, in a minimal fraction of ratings (~4%), from an openly unfavorable standpoint, several point to the pacing and running time as drawn-out, many condemn the presence of racism and offensive humor, and a considerable number reject what they see as the filmmaker's self-indulgent style.
